chapter_level.guidance: This is an અસ્મિતા-ગીત in praise of Gujarat and Gujaratis, and its surface sits close to a slogan; the genre profile itself names this exact chapter as one of the two most tempted toward slogan-writing and political framing. Every explanation, real_life_example and recall answer must stay with the poem's own pictures — સૂર્યનાં કિરણો, ઉષા, ગુર્જર વાણી-લહાણી-શાણી, જંગલમાં મંગલ, ગુર્જર ભરતી-છાતી, સ્નેહ-શૌર્ય-સત્યનો રાસ — and never widen into 'આપણે ગુજરાત માટે … જોઈએ' exhortation, never name a government, party, scheme or border, and never frame ગુજરાત as superior to another state or region.
